pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on adding positions within 60 seconds of a prior entry; pyramiding is limited to strictly verified trend continuations where the initial position is already at breakeven + trailing.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 3-bar structural volume expansion and ATR-normalized breakout confirmation before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop-lock whenever floating profit crosses +$12.00 to guarantee terminal exit between $15.00 and $30.00.
